summary: iOS service objectives evaluate replicated durable phone minute summaries across the fleet, with save-before-upload and idempotent outage replay

replay.detail: New minute claims and trusted operation receipts replicate through the existing claim log. Native iOS evaluation rebuilds from those claims after restart or replication. Previous local diagnostic JSONL is not fleet evidence and is not imported; phone pending bins:2 storage remains readable.

schema.detail: Adds durable once-only custom.client.observation-minute with source/device identity and pairing provenance; adds partial claims_observation_report_index and claims_observation_minute_time_index seek indexes. Registry digest and convergence corpus advance; storage version is unchanged. No phone wire/codegen change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules are unchanged. New summaries remain ordinary durable replicated claims; mixed-version members may retain unknown-kind evidence until upgraded.

compatibility.detail: The existing observations endpoint commits source-owned claims before the unchanged local diagnostic admission. The held request-latency endpoint retains its member-local phone windows; native SLO rows and doctor use replicated claims only. A same-process report retry through a replacement pairing can still receive legacy diagnostic HTTP 409 even after durable deduplication. Diagnostic cutover needs a separately authorized freeze exemption; do not activate until that boundary is resolved. Older receivers acknowledge only local diagnostics and cannot establish fleet coverage.

downtime.detail: Opening an existing store installs two additive partial indexes before service starts. Startup duration on large retained claim stores is unmeasured. No full graph replay or manual reset is required.

manual.detail: Live daemon rollout, app installation and phone interaction require the operator's explicit activation GO. Verify authenticated summary claims replicate and native row evidence agrees across members before claiming fleet coverage. Missing minutes remain unknown.

recovery.detail: Retain graph claims and phone storage on rollback. Older readers do not provide the new fleet-wide authority; do not clear pending reports or treat historical local diagnostics as replicated minutes. Additive indexes can remain in place.
